hero.title: We Believe Every Child Deserves to Play
hero.subtitle: ToyZone was built by parents, educators, and dreamers who know that the right toy at the right moment can spark a lifelong love of learning, creativity, and adventure.
hero.description: ToyZone was born from a simple idea: the right toy at the right moment can change a child's life. For over 12 years, we have been curating safe, imaginative, and joyful toys for families everywhere.

story.title: From a Small Shop to a Million Smiles
story.subtitle: From a garage shelf to a global family, here is the story of how we grew — one toy, one child, one smile at a time.
story.p1: In 2012, Sarah Mitchell opened a tiny toy shop in San Francisco with 200 carefully chosen products and a big dream. She had spent years as a child psychologist watching how the right toy could unlock creativity, build confidence, and strengthen family bonds.
story.p2: What started as a neighborhood favorite quickly grew into something much larger. Families drove hours to visit, and soon the demand for an online store was impossible to ignore. Today, ToyZone ships to every corner of the country, but our founding philosophy has never changed.
bullets: Every toy is tested by real children before we stock it
We partner only with manufacturers who meet our ethical sourcing standards
Our team includes educators, child psychologists, and parents
We donate 1% of every sale to childhood literacy programs

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy on all items. Products must be in original packaging and unused condition. Simply contact us and we'll arrange a pickup.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Express shipping (1–2 days) is available at checkout. Orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping.

items.question: Are your toys safety certified?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every product in our store meets or exceeds ASTM and CPSC safety standards. We only carry toys that have passed rigorous testing for all age groups.

items.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
items.answer: Yes! Gift wrapping is available for $4.99 per item. You can add a personalized message card at no extra charge. Select the option at checkout.

items.question: Can I place a bulk or school order?
items.answer: We love working with schools, daycares, and event planners. Contact us directly for bulk pricing and we'll put together a custom quote within 48 hours.
